qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507.mistake:
Yes. Two mistakes: 
- FOL ∀x (p_4(x) ∨ p_10(x)) does not restrict x to detectives, but NL says 'every detective'.
- Similarly, ∀x (p_8(x) → p_5(x)) says 'anyone', but NL specifies 'any detective'.
These are quantifier scope mismatches.
